The product brief that arrives before the meeting.

Meridian reads support, usage, and customer conversations, then writes a weekly brief your whole company can finish before standup.

The company

Meridian Labs builds Meridian, a writing layer for product teams. It turns the week's support, usage, and customer conversations into one brief the company can read together. Meridian Labs is an independent company based in San Francisco.

We built Meridian because Monday kept starting with twelve tabs and no shared picture. The brief is the picture. We hope it gives you the hour back.

The product

One brief

A single page of what changed, in plain language, waiting at the top of Monday.

Sources attached

Each line links to the ticket, the call, or the chart it came from. Nothing to take on trust.

Themes, not piles

Similar notes collapse into a few themes, so the brief stays short as the week gets louder.

The same story

Product, success, and leadership get one brief. Not three versions of the week.
